validation_notes: The overall structure from early July through early August is a persistent downtrend with lower highs and lower lows, not a converging triangle. Price dropped from ~0.051 to ~0.041 with no clear flattening support line - the 'lows' around 0.044-0.045 (late July) briefly stabilized but then broke down further to ~0.041, and the most recent price action (Aug 2-6) is simply drifting sideways/slightly down in a tight range around 0.041-0.044 without any clear rising support or converging resistance. There's no well-defined descending upper trendline with 3+ touches of lower highs converging against a flat support - the recent consolidation looks more like a flag/range after the downtrend than an active triangle apex. I don't see the two distinct converging boundaries required to call this a credible descending triangle; it looks more like trend continuation/consolidation noise near the lows.
